sections.heading: C2 — Knowledge continuation and confusables: Licensing eligibility and documents
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Knowledge continuation and confusables: Licensing eligibility and documents

FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A06
Naturalization certificates on Form N-550, N-570 or N-578 are among the accepted primary identity documents. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A06
Citizenship certificates on Form N-560, N-561 or N-645 are among the accepted primary identity documents. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A06
A valid foreign passport stamped Processed for I-551 is an accepted primary identity document. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A06
A permit to reenter the United States on Form I-327 is an accepted primary identity document. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A06
A refugee travel document on Form I-571 is an accepted primary identity document. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A06
A person transferring a federally compliant license or identification card from another state uses the handbook’s document list for renewal of a credential with a front-side star. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A06
Name-change proof is required when the applicant’s current full legal name differs from the primary identity document or a previously issued South Dakota credential used a different name from that document. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A06
Name-change documents must link the selected identity document to the current full legal name, using more than 1 document when needed to complete that link. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A06
Accepted name-change documents include a certified marriage certificate or a court name-change order issued through a petition, divorce, annulment or adoption. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R10 | anchor: A06
A marriage certificate used for name-change proof must be a certified copy from the vital-statistics office or equivalent agency where the marriage occurred, bearing the issuing authority’s stamp or raised seal. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R11 | anchor: A06
A certificate issued by a church, chapel or similar institution is not acceptable marriage-certificate proof for the licensing name change. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R12 | anchor: A06
A court order used for name-change proof must show the previous full legal name, court-ordered full legal name and date of birth, and bear the official court seal. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R13 | anchor: A06
A date stamp or filing stamp does not qualify as the official court seal required on a name-change order. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R14 | anchor: A06
Photocopies and faxed copies of a name-change court order are unacceptable. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R15 | anchor: A06
Social Security proof must show the current name and complete Social Security number on a Social Security card, W-2, Social Security Administration 1099, other 1099, or paystub. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R16 | anchor: A06
A temporary foreign national who is not authorized to work need not document a Social Security number, but South Dakota will verify the person’s USCIS number. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R17 | anchor: A06
A person eligible to work who lacks a Social Security number must obtain and present one. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R18 | anchor: A06
The handbook says the licensing program cannot accept documents outside its specified list as proof of a Social Security number. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R19 | anchor: A06
The new-credential application requires 2 documents showing a South Dakota physical address that are less than 1 year old. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R20 | anchor: A06
A minor may use a parent’s address documents only when the accompanying parent’s name appears on those documents. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R21 | anchor: A06
Physical-address evidence may include utility or phone bills, bank statements, pay or earnings statements, mortgage documents, rent receipts, tax documents, homeowners or renters insurance, and accredited-school transcripts or report cards. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R22 | anchor: A06
An examiner may review other items bearing the applicant’s address as possible physical-address evidence. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R23 | anchor: A07
A full-time traveler using a South Dakota mail-forwarding address must complete a Residency Affidavit. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R24 | anchor: A07
The full-time-traveler address route requires a receipt from a South Dakota hotel, motel, campground or RV park establishing a stay of at least 1 night within the previous year. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R25 | anchor: A07
The full-time-traveler address route also requires the South Dakota personal-mailbox contract or agreement. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R26 | anchor: A07
For the full-time-traveler route, 1 document no more than 1 year old must prove the personal-mailbox service address, using a mailbox-business receipt or mail bearing that address. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R27 | anchor: A07
A full-time traveler planning to use a friend’s or relative’s South Dakota address may follow the Consent for Use of Address form and its instructions. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R28 | anchor: A07
Maintaining a residence in another state disqualifies a person from the handbook’s full-time-traveler category. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R29 | anchor: A07
An honorably discharged veteran may request Veteran on a South Dakota license or identification card by adding discharge proof to the ordinary required documents. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R30 | anchor: A07
The veteran-designation proof list allows a DD-214 showing honorable active-duty discharge, a county or tribal veterans-service-officer certificate of honorable status, DD Form 2 Retired, DD Form 2A Reserve Retired, or NGB Form 22. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R31 | anchor: A07
A male license applicant aged 18 through 25 must state that he registered with Selective Service or authorize DPS to send the information needed to register him. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R32 | anchor: A07
The handbook connects Selective Service registration with eligibility for federal student aid, job training and government jobs. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R33 | anchor: A07
The printed fee schedule, which is marked subject to change, lists $38 for a regular driver license or instruction permit issued as an upgrade, new credential, renewal or interstate transfer. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R34 | anchor: A07
The printed schedule marked subject to change lists $38 for a new, renewed or interstate-transfer identification card. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R35 | anchor: A07
The printed schedule marked subject to change lists $20 for a name change, address change or replacement license or identification card. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R36 | anchor: A07
A testing fee permits 3 test attempts within 6 months, after which another fee is required if the attempts or time allowance have been used up. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R37 | anchor: A07
An applicant younger than 21 receives a prorated fee when the issued license will last less than 5 years. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R38 | anchor: A07
Someone owing at least $1,000 in child-support arrears cannot receive a normal South Dakota driver license, although the handbook allows possible eligibility for 1 temporary license lasting 6 months. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R39 | anchor: A07
A person deemed medically or psychologically unfit to drive is excluded from obtaining a South Dakota driver license. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0007]

ranked.label: Pedagogic emphasis: Match eligibility and each document requirement to the correct application route.
